title: Tighten backend authorization and data integrity rules

requirements.text: Require that the caller has an existing user profile (not just an AccessControl #user permission) to use user/report endpoints: getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, createReport, listReports, and getReportById. If the profile does not exist, reject the call with a clear trap message instructing the user to sign up first.
acceptanceCriteria: A principal that has no entry in userProfiles cannot create/list/fetch reports and cannot save a profile; each affected method traps with an English message indicating signup is required.
Existing signed-up users can still use all endpoints as before.

requirements.text: Harden signup and report creation against client-supplied privileged fields by enforcing server authority: during signupWithCode, ignore any incoming profile.role value and always store role = #engineer for new signups; during createReport, ignore any incoming report.createdBy value and always store createdBy = caller (current behavior) and ensure this is the only persisted creator value.
acceptanceCriteria: New signups always persist with role = #engineer regardless of what the frontend sends.
Reports always persist with createdBy = caller regardless of what the frontend sends.
No endpoint allows a non-admin to set themselves (or anyone else) to #admin.

requirements.text: Prevent report overwrites by enforcing report ID uniqueness in createReport: if a report with the same id already exists, reject the call with a clear trap message rather than overwriting the existing report.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling createReport with an id that already exists traps with an English error message indicating the id already exists.
Calling createReport with a new id succeeds and the report is stored.

requirements.text: When an admin deletes a user via deleteUser, also remove/revoke that user's authorization role(s) in AccessControl so the deleted principal cannot continue to pass permission checks after deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleteUser completes, the deleted principal can no longer pass backend permission checks as a #user/#admin (i.e., they must sign up again to regain access).
deleteUser continues to remove the user profile and all reports createdBy that user as it does today.
Admins still cannot delete their own account (existing behavior remains).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional canisters/services).
Use English for any user-facing trap/error messages.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Changing the access code value (must remain exactly "646151").
Adding third-party authentication or any non-Internet-Identity auth provider.
Adding real-time features (WebSockets/push) or external database integration.
